content.title: Tour of Flanders 2026
content.text: Tadej Pogacar won the 110th Tour of Flanders ahead of Mathieu van der Poel and Remco Evenepoel. The iconic race across Flanders covered 278.2 kilometres and included sixteen cobbled climbs. The 2026 Tour of Flanders was held on Sunday 5 April. Check race results/report 2026 Tour of Flanders, and read about the route and start list. Another interesting read: winners and records Tour of Flanders. Tour of Flanders 2026: routes, profiles, videos Click the images to enlarge + Click for more images (33) - Click for less images Pogacar triumphs in battle of giants On the second ascent of the Oude Kwaremont, with 57 kilometres to go, Tadej Pogacar accelerates and only Remco Evenepoel and Mathieu van der Poel are able to match his move. On the Paterberg, the Belgian is dropped, while the world champion shakes off the Dutchman on the final Oude Kwaremont. Pogacar thus wins the Tour of Flanders for the third time, becoming joint record-holder. Read more » Winners and records The Tour of Flanders is one of cycling's 5 Monuments. It is of huge importance to Belgian riders, teams, sponsors and of course the massive crowds of Flemish cycling fanatics that line the route each year. Therefore, no surprise that Flemish riders feature heavily in the list of race winners. Read more » Route Sunday 5 April -This year's High Mass of Flemish cycling begins in Antwerp. The route spans 278.2 kilometres, featuring sixteen (cobbled) climbs and seven flat cobbled sections. As usual, the Tour of Flanders comes down to the last 55 kilometres, with the cobbled Kwaremont–Paterberg combo as the final obstacles before a 13-kilometre flat run-in. Read more » Riders Title holder and two-time winner Tadej Pogacar returns to Flanders to defend his crown, while three-time winner Mathieu van der Poel aims to regain it. Wout van Aert, Remco Evenepoel and Mads Pedersen are also there to set the race alight. Cyclingstage.com brings you the start list for 'De Ronde'.
